title.narrative: Procurement for the project "Support to Regionalisation of PSM in Ukraine"
Upphandling inom projektet ”Stöd till regionaliseringen av PSM i Ukraina”

description.narrative: This contribution aims at procuring an intermediary in Ukraine who would tackle the procurement of equiment, software and technical services necessary for the implementation of the Project 11150 "Support to regionalisation of public service media in Ukraine" in 2018-2020. The procurement intermediary will handle all the procurement necessary for the Project 11150 in line with Sida regulations and the legislation of Ukraine.
